title: President Donald Trump tells 10-year-old rescued by teen lifeguard he “wouldn’t” have risked his life to save him
summary_full: In a remarkable display of courage, 16-year-old lifeguard Ryder Williams saved Nathanial Rai, a young boy, from perilous waters at the California beach. Their heroic rescue, which gained significant attention after going viral, caught the eye of President Donald Trump, who invited both to the White House. Williams emphasized his rigorous training and swift action during the rescue, sparking conversations about lifeguards' official recognition as first responders.
